'''Dewback slim sip''' was a dish served at [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] in [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]]. It was made from [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] meat and was listed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on the diner menu.<ref name="MIA" />
